notes: Turn 105 (his answer of 2026-10-24 18:40 UTC, experiments/t105-answers/JOEL-20261024-1840.md): 101.1, GPT's rewrite of my paragraph, word for word as he pasted it ("GPT was able to fix that paragraph on its first try, it got human high conf on pangram"). It carries the guide's line 505 points the paragraph had: repeated milder confusion or spacing out, help when it's severe or happens sober, and no sudden stop of a medication or a substance the body depends on. What my four drafts got wrong is gate E256.

beside.label: Before
beside.text: Milder reactions afterward count as caution signs too, like getting confused or spaced out (dissociating) again and again. Get professional help right away if any of this is severe or risky, and especially if it keeps going or comes back while you're sober. Don't suddenly quit a prescribed medicine, or anything your body is dependent on, just because it might be part of the problem; have a doctor help you stop safely.
